raw_transcription:
I'll see you next time.
And I'll be true to the world for a time
Just to see if I could rewrite the line
Yeah
Your touch is a razor cutting feet through my skin
Undhincter to the quiet that best serves my friend
I drift through the horizon with the rise to light
These footsteps they seem the wake of the time
So that comes the revolution of all that we start
Out of the tiny holes in the fabric of the world
So that you'll never be able to survive
Let's wait stars
Out there, there ain't no wall
There's no fabric, no girl
Way high
Can you see the stranger
I've become within your eyes
Or is it just a distance
Where our truth now lies
Standing on the edge
Where the sun is, Mr. Stone
Reaching for a rule
It can never be found
Side moves forward
But I'm trapped beneath the moon
In no more there's ever changing
I will never move
Now I'm alone
Stop there for so long
Now I'm alone
To stay there for this day shall
All right
Is the city tension you crave
When you push me away
I wish you could have seen
What you'll be trying
Your life will hard to wait
And then the craze
Roll
Time to save you
Let's just chop through the walls
The flame chop through
And the walls are kept still
By the last way down
And the pain will fade
A cycle of hatred will do
The pain
Standing on the edge
Where the sun is, Mr. Stone
Reaching for a rule
It can never be found
Side moves forward
But I'm trapped beneath the moon
In no more there's ever changing
I will never move
Now I'm alone
It is all right
And the death won't go
